{{Quote|So you wrote it, then?''"<br />"''Of course I did. I don't know how anyone got hold of it and why it would have been posted, but yes, I wrote it.|Yara Grugara and Osten Dal'Nay, on Dal'Nay's authorship of The Best Defense|<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" />}}
'''The Best Defense''' was a story written during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Osten Dal'Nay]], a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Thaereian military]], and depicted the [[Death/Legends|killing]] of the [[Thaereian]] military [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Kulkis]] by the soldier [[Nightwing]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the story was circulated on the [[Cularin holonet node]], resulting in speculation that it depicted true events and that Dal'Nay was the real Nightwing.
 
==Description==
{{Quote|The best fiction is veined with truth. It's hard to create a character like Kulkis from nothing. He was a rotten individual, foul to his core. He did beat his soldiers, and anyone else who got in his way. I think every enlisted person I ever met who served under him had a different way in which they wanted him to die. One of them finally got their wish.|Osten Dal'Nay, on the characterization of Kulkis in The Best Defense|<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" />}}
The Best Defense was a story written by the young [[Thaereian military]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Osten Dal'Nay]].<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> The story depicted the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Thaereian]] military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kulkis]] in self-defense by the Thaereian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Nightwing]].<ref name="The Best Defense" /> Though a work of fiction, The Best Defense was inspired by the death of the real Kulkis, who had a reputation for cruelty to his subordinates and died after being thrown out of the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Dal'Nay had met Kulkis and had little regard for the Thaereian commander. Dal'Nay considered the tale a metaphor illustrating that that not every command should be obeyed, and that not all leaders deserve loyalty.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an anonymous party distributed the story on the Cularin holonet node<ref name="The Best Defense" /> without consent from Dal'Nay.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> This led to [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] users speculating regarding the nature of the story, with many theorizing that Dal'Nay had written the tale and that he was the true Nightwing.<ref name="Everyone's a Critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic|int=Everyone's a Critic (article)}}</ref> Dal'Nay later admitted in an interview with the broadcaster [[Yara Grugara]] that he had written The Best Defense, but denied that the story depicted real events.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" />

==Synopsis==
{{Quote|In the dark, there is no difference between an enemy and a friend. In the midst of a firefight, a blaster bolt from your brother's carbine kills just as surely as a bolt from the followers of a Hutt. Life and death know no relations, never shake hands with you, never wait to see if their arrival is welcome or their departure serene. And the only thing any being can do, when the time comes, is his duty.|The opening of The Best Defense|<ref name="The Best Defense" />}}
Sitting on his [[Sleeper (furniture)|bunk]], Thaereian soldier Nightwing obsessively tends to his malfunctioning [[MX9]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. When the feared and enigmatic [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] officer Commander Kulkis unexpectedly confronts him, a tense philosophical exchange about the nature of defense escalates into a deadly test. Provoked by a sudden knife attack, Nightwing kills Kulkis in self-defense, discovering too late that the attack was a brutal lesson rather than an assassination. As he jettisons Kulkis' body into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Nightwing is haunted by the Nikto officer's cryptic final words.<ref name="The Best Defense" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Best Defense first featured in the [[2005]] [[Wizards.com]] article ''[[The Best Defense (article)|The Best Defense]]'' by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]], a tie-in to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign. The article presented the text of the in-universe The Best Defense, though did not explicitly confirm The Best Defense to be the in-universe name of the story.<ref name="The Best Defense" /> The story was subsequently referenced in the Wizards.com ''Living Force'' tie-in articles ''[[Everyone's a Critic (article)|Everyone's a Critic]]''<ref name="Everyone's a Critic" /> and ''[[Osten Dal'Nay (article)|Osten Dal'Nay]]'',<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> also both written by Mullins.<ref name="Everyone's a Critic" /><ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> The ''Osten Dal'Nay'' article confirmed the in-universe name of the story to be The Best Defense.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" />
